Lower Text: [All Turns] When an opponent's effect would delete this Digimon, you may play 1 [Parasitemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Hand] [Main] By paying 4 cost and placing this card as 1 of your level 5 or higher Digimon's bottom digivolution card, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and attack an opponent's Digimon with the Digimon this was placed under.
[End of Attack] You may place this Digimon as 1 of your other Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
